Bhagavad Gita, Chapter 1, Verse 36

“What pleasure could be ours, Janardana, from killing the sons of Dhritarashtra? Only sin would come upon us by slaying these aggressors.”

Arjuna uses the word atatayin, aggressor — the legal term for someone whose killing is permitted. He grants his enemies that status and still concludes the act would stain him.
